deities: Kalika Mata (fierce form of Goddess Kali/Durga, Shakti)

history.period: Modern era (founding date not recorded in consulted sources)
history.summary: Kalika Mata Temple is a prominent Shakti shrine on Kalika Mata Road, Anand Colony, Shastri Nagar, Ratlam - one of the city's most visited goddess temples and a centre of religious activity, with a small market grown around it. Devotees believe the temple's three goddess idols (well-crafted per local accounts) fulfil wishes; it sits on a hilltop setting within the city. The temple is in the news as of June 2026, when Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Dr. Mohan Yadav publicly invoked the blessings of Ratlam's Kalika Mata for prosperity and health. Note: several small shrines in the Ratlam region share the 'Kalika Mata' name (e.g. at Dhamnod and near the Collectorate) - this entry documents the well-established Anand Colony/Shastri Nagar temple, the one described on Ratlam city temple guides.

name: Kalika Mata Temple
town_description: Ratlam is a historic Malwa-region city in western Madhya Pradesh (~1,575 ft elevation), famed for its sev, the 11th-century Veerupaksh Mahadev temple, the Cactus Garden and the Dholawad Dam; the temple stands in the Shastri Nagar area of the city.

travel.airport: Devi Ahilya Bai Holkar Airport, Indore (~140 km) is the nearest commercial airport (per state tourism listings).
travel.railway: Ratlam Junction is the nearest major railway station (~3 km), a major Delhi-Mumbai junction.
travel.road: Easily reachable by city road within Ratlam (Kalika Mata Road, Anand Colony, Shastri Nagar); autos and local buses available.

visitor_information.best_time: Navratri and Diwali for the main festivities; October to March for pleasant weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Typical morning-to-evening darshan; published hours not found in consulted sources (verify locally). Neighbouring Kalika shrines list ~6:00 AM-10:00 PM, but that timing belongs to other listings, not this temple.
